brand.name: Domain Cigars
brand.description: Not on the site at all - confirmed absent from the site's full 112-brand index. CORRECTION TO AN INITIAL ASSUMPTION: 'Domain' was initially hypothesized to be a line of AJ Fernandez (already a listed brand) - research ruled this out. Domain is its own standalone brand, founded March 2024 by Daniel Lance (cigar retail background, founder of Lujo Concepts) and Esteban Disla (cigar-making veteran, ~10 years at Fabrica de Tabacos Nica Sueno S.A.; earlier at Latin Cigars S.A./now STG Esteli; created blends for CAO, Toraño, Alec Bradley). A full-service tobacco company (agriculture, processing, brokering, cigar making). Its absence from the site's index is consistent with it being a genuinely new brand (launched March 2024), not evidence it's fictional.

line.name: Domain Entropy
line.description: Domain's third regular-production line (after Neutron and Negentropy, both debuted April 2024). A refined, regular-production evolution of an earlier limited prototype called 'No7B' - roughly 90% of Entropy's blend is derived from Negentropy, with a different broadleaf crop and one filler viso change versus the No7B prototype. Pre-orders opened October 2024; began shipping to retailers around November 2024.
line.factory: Tabacalera Familia Disla S.A., Esteli, Nicaragua

research_notes: The Mac photo 'Domain_Entropy-Robx_01.jpg' is AMBIGUOUS between 'Robusto Extra' (5x52) and 'Robusto Gordo' (5x56) - no source uses 'Robx' as an official abbreviation for either, and both exist in the confirmed lineup. NOT resolved to one specific vitola for that photo - both are listed above as confirmed line vitolas, but the photo itself isn't attributed to either with confidence. A 4th vitola, 'Belicoso Shaggy - His Excellency' (5x54, ~$14.99/cigar), and a later expansion vitola referenced in a 2026 review ('Corona Heritage Cabinet Agile') were also found but have no matching Mac photo and full specs weren't pulled for the latter.
